In the CLI probe, authenticated removal keeps the same per-image lock and staging and refuses a second CLI build. SIGTERM leaves the pending notice and identity with zero confirmations. delino-win-1: The focused tests run without skips or elevation. Pending removal and exclusive lock both refuse the CLI before layout creation. Two shared handles in separate processes coexist, an exclusive reset waits, and reset completes after release.
The same-destination image lock rejects a second holder, distinct destinations work concurrently, and the Windows executable reports the worker revision with vcs.modified=false.

privilegedScenarios.reason: The macOS builder requires root to install the guest helper. This host account has no available administrator password. Use a compatible local test IPSW, the macOS SDK and a provisioned root-capable test session to run the signed image build.
privilegedScenarios.setup: Run after the non-elevated setup. Place a compatible non-production Apple Silicon IPSW at "$probe_dir/restore.ipsw". Check for enough free space for a disposable 64 GiB sparse build disk.
expectedResults: The signed macOS image CLI reaches native disk staging and the probe pauses it before publication. Authenticated removal leaves the lock and staging present, rejects another build and keeps the notice and identity when interrupted.
On retry, cancel and resume the paused builder. After the builder exits, removal confirms exactly once and leaves only the empty enrollment lock.
